purpose: Permanent R41 coverage census and baseline. No failing towers on the current tree. No geometry mutation.

rule.crop: Tight bounding box containing all pixels with minRGB >= 240
rule.scaling: Isotropic preserving aspect ratio: if crop_h >= crop_w then (new_h=128, new_w=max(1, round(crop_w * 128.0 / crop_h))) else (new_w=128, new_h=max(1, round(crop_h * 128.0 / crop_w))) with Python round (ties-to-even)
rule.sampling: Exact integer nearest center lookup: ((2 * np.arange(out_size, dtype=np.int64) + 1) * in_size) // (2 * out_size) clipped to in_size - 1 applied directly to binary tight crop array
rule.padding: Center padding with pad_top = (128 - new_h) // 2, pad_left = (128 - new_w) // 2

regimeNote: Masks use the actual browser layout. The Node layout is saved separately. Seeded presentation heights differ across these runtimes for 30 rows. Identity positions and source dimensions remain explicitly bound.
selectionNote: The historical 137 IDs were not preserved. This fixed sample was selected before grading. The full 211 census covers every current tower.
